evals.prompt: Outline a 30-minute conference talk about migrating to Kubernetes.
evals.expected_output: Defines audience and one-sentence message, three points with evidence, a hook, ending with takeaways, a timed outline, and slide headlines.
expectations: Hook in the first minute, not an agenda
Timed sections that fit 30 minutes with slack
Ending before Q&A with next steps

evals.prompt: I want to cover 8 lessons we learned in my 20-minute talk.
evals.expected_output: Recommends cutting to three points that support one message and moving the rest to a blog post or appendix.
expectations: Suggests where the rest can go

evals.prompt: I'm doing a live demo of our CLI on stage over conference Wi-Fi.
evals.expected_output: Plans a scripted demo with pre-loaded data and a recorded fallback.
